description: Translates text to Morse code or Morse code to text. Returns the result, a letter-by-letter breakdown with the dot and dash patterns, the signal timing at the chosen speed and a link to the SandiMorse translator with the same input. The widget plays the sound and blinks a lamp.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the page the link opens: id for Indonesian or en for English. Default id.

text.description: The text to translate, or Morse code written with dots and dashes (letters separated by spaces, words by /).

wpm.description: Sending speed in words per minute for the timing. Default 15.

name: translate_morse
title: Translate Morse code
